changelog:
CSM 1.0.879

Notifications

• The placeholder notifications are gone. The old demo entries ("Welcome to
  CS3M Notifications!" and "Pro Tip: Custom Themes") are removed from the feed,
  and from now on only real announcements are shown.
• The preview in CSM's notification settings no longer invents a card. It shows
  the real content: the cached update card when one exists, otherwise the
  notifications that are actually being served, otherwise a plain notice that
  there is nothing to show right now.
• An empty, missing or failed feed is now simply silent: no placeholder card, no
  toast.
• Fixed the feed source order: the fresh source is requested first and the
  mirror is only a fallback. The mirror cached the old feed for hours and served
  removed placeholder entries long after they were deleted.
• Old "CS3M" naming is gone from notification texts and identifiers.

Appearance

• More of CSM's own interface follows your palette: source index badges, source
  rank and quality badges, series meta chips, the view inspector's filter and
  tree styling, the video-info badge on the player, and every CSM settings page
  and dialog shell, including the reorder rows, the search fields and the
  diagnostics dashboard.
• Settings load the CSM palette through one resolver, update in place when you
  change a colour or preset, and restore the host colours when CSM is off.
• Unchanged on purpose: rank and score medals, quality, language and year tiers,
  notification type accents, error and destructive states, the black video dimming
  layer, the video-scrim action buttons and their white glyphs, and the controls
  that hold your own picked colours.
• CloudStream's own screens keep CloudStream's own theme. Their colours are
  literal resources and their Compose theme is built inside CloudStream itself;
  CSM cannot repaint those views. That was verified, not assumed.

Episode totals

• The result page's hero poster now shows the real episode total too, taken from
  the response CloudStream has already loaded, without any extra request.
• The on-demand loading stays bounded and honest: at most four series per screen,
  two at a time, identical cards coalesced, results cached ten minutes, failures
  suppressed a minute so a broken provider is not hammered, and a provider that is
  uninstalled or switched off mid-flight delivers nothing. A failed or empty load
  leaves no badge, and progress, quality or title text is never used as a count.
• The setting still explains that it may load each series once and use extra data.

Under the hood

• Fixed the write gate defect that could leave CSM's own mutation lease busy for
  the rest of the process, silently blocking clearing protected history and making
  a settings import commit nothing.
• Repaired two order-dependent test defects in the episode-total loader and
  reconciled the remaining pinned source contracts; no assertion was weakened.
